input.query: What should the merchant do when a sale is declined with code 51 or code 05?

content.text:
The sources don't say whether a bank account is mandatory to receive Pix sales. They do describe the Getnet account, Get Conta, as the place where Pix sales can land.

- Get Conta is a free digital account for your business. With it you can send and receive money and sell through Pix [7].
- Pix received through Get Conta counts as account activity [6]. A Pix received in Get Conta can also be held by the MED (Mecanismo Especial de Devolução), the Pix return mechanism [4].
- On Getnet, you receive Pix by generating a QR Code on the capture methods. These are the physical terminals, TEF Auttar and Ecommerce [5].
- The sources don't say whether you can receive Pix sales in a bank account outside Getnet.

MISSING: whether a bank account (Get Conta or another bank) is required to receive Pix sales

You have 2 card machines. One is online and one is offline.

- **T1988A (Get Smart):** online on Wi-Fi with good signal. Last contact was 04/11/2026 at 17:41.
- **T1988B (Get Clássica):** offline, using the chip, with no signal. Last contact was 04/11/2026 at 12:43. It has been offline for 5 hours.

The machine that isn't connecting is probably T1988B. Its data shows no signal.

I can propose a support ticket for T1988B with the reason "no signal" [policy:capabilities]. Nothing runs until you confirm, and an unconfirmed proposal expires after 15 minutes. Do you want me to propose it?

Getnet's antecipação lets you receive credit-card sales early, whether they were paid in full or in installments. You don't have to wait for the normal settlement period before the money reaches your account [8].

- **Timing:** A sales schedule is available for advance from D+1 (one business day after the sale). It stays available until D-3, which is three business days before the schedule settles into your account [7].
- **Default receiving options:** Debit sales are available the next day. For credit, you can choose to receive everything in 2 days, in 30 days, or month by month following the customer's installments [6].
- **Card brands:** Sales from some brands you've enabled can't be advanced through Getnet. Those can only be advanced with the brand's own operator [7].
- **Automatic Advance:** On the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" receiving plan, Automatic Advance is a condition for getting the fee exemption. It goes through credit approval, and Getnet assesses each contract individually [3].
- **Liens (gravame):** If you use your receivables as collateral for a loan, a lien (gravame) directs your receivables schedule to the lender. Sales from Getnet and other acquirers are then paid into your Get Conta, up to the outstanding loan balance [1][2].

The sources I found don't give a fee for the advance itself. They also don't give the steps to request one.

Get Conta, a free digital account for your business, can receive your Pix sales. It lets you send and receive money and sell through Pix [sup-get-conta-02].

- Pix received in Get Conta counts as account activity [sup-get-conta-15]. It can also be held by the MED (Mecanismo Especial de Devolução), the Pix return mechanism [sup-pix-mais-respostas-24].

The main differences are who each machine is for and how much you need to sell for it to be free. The Get Clássica is valid for CPF and CNPJ, and it's free with sales from R$10,000 [5]. The Get Smart is exclusive to CNPJ with revenue above R$10 thousand/month, and it's free with sales from R$60,000 [6]. By the 2025 offer pages, both have a free account and card, receipt in 2 days, and a single rate across the main card brands [5][6].

The Get Smart is a smart card machine. You can control stock, place orders, close tabs, load a menu and issue invoices directly on the device [1]. It runs on Android and can connect to your business system [1][4]. Whether it prints the NF-e depends on the app you choose [4].

The Clássica page lists these single rates: debit 1.69%, credit 1x 3.79%, 2x 7.98%, 3x 8.47%, 4x 8.96% and 5x 9.45% (2025 page, which may be outdated) [5]. For the Get Smart, you pay Getnet the rental and administrative fees, while app subscriptions are charged by the app developers [9].

If your card machine won't connect, you can try these steps from the passages:

- **Chip (SIM):** Turn the machine off and open the back cover. Put the chip in the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal side facing down. Close the cover and turn the machine on. Wait for the data network to connect. When it shows a connected network (2G or 3G), it is ready to use. Then run a communication test to check the chip's connectivity [1].
- **Signal fluctuation (Error ADQ 1-84):** This error happens when the machine's signal fluctuates. Press the Function key and enter 25. The screen turns green. Enter the Operator Password and the screen turns green again. Select Function 46, and the screen turns green once more. Then make a test sale [4].
- **Power:** The key combinations to turn the machine on or off depend on your model [2].

input.query: How many installments can a sale be split into with the crediário?
Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?

content.text:
Up to 48 installments. The Crediário lets your customer split a purchase into up to 48 times on a credit card [1][3]. The maximum number and the interest rate depend on the card issuer, because each issuer sets its own installment limit under its credit policies [2][4].

You can check the interest before the sale. Run a simulation on the card machine by choosing credit > crediário, inserting the card and entering the amount. You can also print the simulation receipt if the machine has paper roll [2]. The simulation is for reference only. It is subject to credit analysis, and the card issuer decides whether to approve the transaction [2].

You can split a sale into up to 48 installments on a credit card with the Crediário [prod-crediario-03][prod-crediario-01].

The maximum number and the interest rate depend on the card issuer, because each issuer sets its own installment limit [sup-crediario-03][prod-crediario-02].

Yes, you can sell through WhatsApp with the Payment Link. The seller can send the link to customers by social media, WhatsApp, email and SMS, and the customer clicks it, chooses the payment method and completes the purchase [1]. The Getnet Payment Link page also lists "Sell from anywhere" as a benefit, which means making sales through WhatsApp or your social network [2]. You don't need an active website to generate a link [5].
